deploy.startCommand: sh -lc "PY=$(command -v python3 || command -v python); \"$PY\" -c \"import os,zlib,base64;s=os.environ['APP_ZLIB_B64_A']+os.environ['APP_ZLIB_B64_B']+os.environ['APP_ZLIB_B64_C'];open('/tmp/shichiya_runtime.py','wb').write(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(s)))\" && exec \"$PY\" -m uvicorn shichiya_runtime:app --app-dir /tmp --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8000}"
